_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base-rate (3% breakers) plus flat leg and legal-rung lock make HOLD the only skilled call until a named breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both cautionary/non-directional on immediate tape; analyst explicit HOLD, narrative silent on phase but leverage-risk framed
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear_greed holds 32-46, BTC range-bound, ETF flows/stablecoin growth/funding unchanged
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear_greed <31 on long-unwind or ETF+stablecoin rebound together pushing fear_greed >47
